header.label: OpenAEC Ecosystem
header.title: OpenAEC Cloud Platform
header.desc: Central cloud platform for the OpenAEC ecosystem. Project management, user management, SSO and synchronization.

why.title: Why OpenAEC Cloud?
why.desc: The OpenAEC ecosystem consists of many tools that work together. The Cloud Platform serves as the central hub: project management, user authentication, file synchronization and API gateway for all connected applications.

projects.title: Project management
projects.desc: Central project management for all OpenAEC tools. Create a project once, available everywhere.

sso.title: User management & SSO
sso.desc: Single Sign-On for the entire ecosystem. Log in once, access all tools with role-based authorization.

sync.title: File synchronization
sync.desc: Automatic file synchronization between all tools. Always the latest version, available everywhere.

nextcloud.title: NextCloud integration
nextcloud.desc: Seamless integration with NextCloud for secure file storage and sharing with full control over data.

multitenant.title: Multi-tenant
multitenant.desc: Support for multiple organizations on the same platform with complete data separation and custom configuration.

api.title: API Gateway
api.desc: Central API gateway for all OpenAEC services. Secure communication between tools with rate limiting and monitoring.
